name: Oana Vitellius I
description: A young defender who became an Azorius defender, arbiter, judge and adjudicator after making a deal with Tarem.

description_citations.text: "Tarem". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Young defender Oana loses a case before Johvann III on a technicality.
timeline.quote: Oana lost a case adjudicated by arbiter Johvann III due to a technicality

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarem offers Oana the memories of her grandfather in exchange for a later Dimir service.
timeline.quote: He offered Oana the opportunity to gain the memories of her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius II

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oana agrees, but Tarem alters her memories so she remembers refusing.
timeline.quote: Tarem altered her memories so that she would remember denying him

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thirty years later Tarem returns unaged and reveals the truth.
timeline.quote: Tarem revealed to Oana the truth

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarem asks Oana to falsify a judgment; she refuses, breaking the deal, and flees.
timeline.quote: Oana refused Taram, however, breaking their deal, and fled.

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oana writes a confession and resignation and contacts a trainee for legal help.
timeline.quote: she wrote and signed a letter of confession, her resignation, and abstainment from any future trials

citation.text: "Oana Vitellius I", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarem approaches Oana at a bar and offers her the memories of her dead grandfather in exchange for a later service to the Dimir.
timeline.quote: He approached her and offered her the opportunity to gain the memories of her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius the II

citation.text: "Tarem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oana agrees, but Tarem alters her memory so she recalls refusing, and she builds a guilt-free career as an Azorius defender and judge.
timeline.quote: Tarem altered her memories so that she would remember denying him

citation.text: "Tarem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thirty years later Tarem waits at Oana's home and reveals the truth of the deal, proving it with a memory of her at seven.
timeline.quote: Tarem then revealed to Oana the truth - that she had accepted his deal and that she had no memory of this fact.

citation.text: "Tarem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarem asks Oana to falsify a judgment to free a Dimir agent; she refuses, breaking the deal, and flees.
timeline.quote: Oana refused Tarem however, breaking their deal, and fled.

citation.text: "Tarem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
